gifts: Storybook: "The Secret Garden of Colorful Creatures"
recommendation.rationale: These gifts blend Freya's love for building and art with new, garden‑themed adventures. The LEGO set lets her create blooming structures, while the art kit encourages vibrant illustrations of her creations. The seed kit and garden storybook add a hands‑on, imaginative storyline that brings the world of flowers to life.

wish.text: Dear Freya, at seven you sparkle brighter than the North Star. May your days be filled with blooming gardens, colorful paintings, and wondrous brick creations that grow like magic. Merry Christmas!
